ValidationRule.description: Ensures that the Opportunity and primary Quote have the same Pricebook before the Opportunity can be set to Closed Won - Pending Review or Cancellation - Pending Review.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won - Pending Review"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Cancellation - Pending Review") ), Pricebook2Id != SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.SBQQ__PricebookId__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Opportunity and Quote must have the same Pricebook before the Opportunity can be set to Closed Won - Pending Review or Cancellation - Pending Review. Please select the same Pricebook for both the Opportunity and the primary Quote.
